en: A black‑and‑white postcard view of a large Baroque palace courtyard with ornate facades, arched windows, balustrades lined with statues, and a central gate-like pavilion. In the foreground are formal gardens with curving pools and fountains, and many people strolling around in early 20th‑century clothing. At the bottom, German text identifies the scene as the Zwinger courtyard in Dresden, looking toward the Wallpavillon.
